goals: Start and end a friendly chat with a neighbor, coworker, or stranger at a party.
Keep small talk going with the 3-step answer: answer + one detail + a follow-up question.
Use natural fillers (Well, Actually, Let me see) and reactions (Really? That sounds fun!) instead of silence.
Link words smoothly in common chunks (How about you? Is it ...? kind of).

medium: What have you been up to lately?
What's new at work or at home?
Who do you usually chat with during the day?
hard: What topics are good for small talk in Taiwan? What topics are not?
How do you start a conversation with someone you don't know?
Tell me about an interesting stranger you talked to once.

key_phrases.en: What have you been up to?
It was nice talking to you.

grammar.point_en: Keeping a conversation going: answer + one detail + a follow-up question
grammar.point_zh: 讓對話繼續：回答＋多說一點＋反問
grammar.explain_zh: 用中文聊天時，回答「還好」就可以了，但英文閒聊只說 Fine，對話很快就會停掉。英文的習慣是：先回答，再加一個小細節，最後反問對方，例如 How about you? 反問時要用 do / does / did 開頭，或用 what、where、how 開頭。中文問句沒有 do 這個字，所以特別容易漏掉。

examples.en: Pretty good! I went hiking. How about you?
examples.zh: 還不錯！我去爬山。那你呢？

examples.en: Yes, I live on Minsheng Road. Do you live around here too?
examples.zh: 對，我住民生路。你也住這附近嗎？

examples.en: Not bad, just busy at work. What have you been up to?
examples.zh: 還好，只是工作很忙。你最近在忙什麼？

examples.en: You went to Japan? Where did you go?

common_mistake.why_zh: 中文「你住哪？」沒有助動詞，但英文問句要加 do / does / did。

sound_focus.sentence: Well, it was kind of busy. How about you?

mini_lesson: Step 1 (5 min): Warm-up. Ask 2-3 easy warm-up questions. Notice if she answers with only one word; don't correct yet.

Step 2 (8 min): The 3-step answer. Write 'Answer + 1 detail + question back' on paper and model it ('Pretty good! I went hiking. How about you?'). Ask 4 small-talk questions; she must use all three steps every time.
Step 3 (6 min): Linking. Drill How about you → how-uh-BOW-choo, Is it → i-zit, kind of → kinda, What have you → wuh-duh-vyuh. Say each slowly, then at natural speed; she shadows each one 3 times.

Step 4 (5 min): Fillers and reactions. Teach Well / Actually / Let me see for thinking time, and Really? / That sounds fun! / Same here. for reacting. Tell short news ('I got a puppy!'); she reacts and asks one follow-up question.

Step 5 (6 min): Open and close. Practice an opener ('Is it always this busy here?') and a closer ('I'd better get going. It was nice talking to you!'). Then run a 2-minute mini chat from start to finish.

roleplays.title: Waiting for the Elevator
roleplays.setup_zh: 在大樓電梯口遇到鄰居，簡單聊幾句天。

lines.en: Hi! Hot today, isn't it?
Yes, it's so hot! How are you?
Pretty good, thanks. Busy with work. How about you?
Same here. I'm kind of tired today.
Oh no. Did you do anything fun last weekend?
Actually, yes. I went to ___ with my family. How about you?
lines.zh: 其實有。我跟家人去了___。那你呢？

lines.en: I just stayed home. Oh, here's the elevator!
It was nice talking to you. Have a good day!
lines.zh: 很高興跟你聊天，祝你有美好的一天！

roleplays.title: Meeting Someone at a Party
roleplays.setup_zh: 在朋友的生日派對上遇到一個不認識的人。你要主動開啟話題、用問題讓對話繼續，最後禮貌地結束。
roleplays.teacher_role: Mark, a guest she doesn't know

lines.en: Hi! I don't think we've met. I'm ___.
lines.zh: 嗨！我們好像沒見過。我是___。

lines.en: Hi, I'm Mark. Nice to meet you. How do you know Amy?
Well, we work together. How about you?
We went to college together. Actually, I just moved back from Canada.
Really? That sounds exciting! Where in Canada?
lines.zh: 真的嗎？聽起來好棒！在加拿大哪裡？

lines.en: Vancouver. I lived there for five years.
Oh, I didn't know that. Do you miss it?
lines.zh: 喔，我都不知道耶。你會想念那裡嗎？

lines.en: Sometimes. But I really missed Taiwanese food! What have you been up to lately?
Let me see... I'm learning English, so I'm kind of busy.
lines.zh: 我想想……我在學英文，所以有點忙。

lines.en: Your English is good! By the way, have you tried the cake?
Not yet. Actually, I'd better get going soon. It was nice talking to you!
lines.zh: 還沒。其實我差不多該走了。很高興跟你聊天！

lines.en: You too! Enjoy the rest of the party.

teacher_twists: Give only short answers ('Yeah.' 'Fine.') for a while, so she has to work harder with follow-up questions.
Bring up a surprise topic (your new puppy, a trip, a TV show); she must react with Really? / That sounds fun! and ask one more question.
Keep talking when she tries to leave, so she has to close the conversation politely a second time.

homework_zh: 每天對著鏡子回答 How was your day?，用「回答＋一個細節＋How about you?」三個步驟說出來。
練習連音：How about you、Is it、kind of、What have you been up to 每天各唸 5 次，先慢後快。
看一段英文訪談或 vlog 影片，聽聽看對方用了哪些 Well、Actually、You know，記下 3 個句子。
